tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: I'll call you when I get home.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “When are you going to start dinner?”

B hears the question and builds the answer with a time clause (when, after, until, as soon as …). One rule to watch: for the future, use the present simple after these words, never will. Change the blue verb if you need to (he gets, she finishes).
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Number 1: What will you do when …?

tandemRedemittel.p2: Present simple: 'when I get home', not 'when I will get home'.
